name: Wall Clock
instruction: Design a wall clock that also functions as a decorative piece. The clock should have large, easy-to-read numbers and a sweeping second hand. Around the clock face, add a series of small compartments that can hold tiny decorative items or trinkets. The overall design should be both functional and aesthetically pleasing.

Shape accuracy: The object is a wall clock.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The number is proportionate to thge entire clock.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The clock face is properly positioned for visibility.
The compartments are evenly distributed around the clock face.
Object distance and contact: The compartments do not obstruct the view of the clock numbers.
The second hand moves freely without interference from the compartments.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified attributes of the clock are accurately represented.
The design fulfills the dual function of being a clock and a decorative piece.
